# MediaPipe Tasks Vision

- Package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.18`
- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this folder)
- WASM runtime: `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.{js,wasm}` and `wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.{js,wasm}`
- Model: `model/face_landmarker.task` from
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
  (MediaPipe Face Landmarker, Apache-2.0)

Everything is served locally; no CDN is used at runtime.
